description: See what is waiting to go live on Vercel, Render and the other Deploy Center platforms, and deploy it by hand, from VS Code, Cursor or Windsurf.
config.cliPath.markdownDescription: Full path to the `deploys` command. Empty: the one inside `/Applications/Deploy Center.app`, then `~/Applications`, then `PATH`.
config.scope.description: Which projects the status bar and the tree show.
config.scope.enum.auto: The projects whose repo matches this folder's git remote; all projects when none match.
config.scope.enum.repo: Only the projects whose repo matches this folder's git remote.
config.pollMinutes.description: How often to check, in minutes, while the window has focus. It also checks when the window gets focus again.
config.timeoutSeconds.description: How long one call of the deploys command may take before it is stopped.
config.logLines.description: How many lines of the build log to show.
welcome.missing:
The deploys command was not found.
[Get Deploy Center](https://deploycenter.app)
Or set its path in [Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22deployCenter.cliPath%22).
welcome.empty:
Nothing is waiting. Every project is on its newest commit.
[Refresh](command:deployCenter.refresh)
welcome.nomatch:
No project deploys from this folder's repo. To see every project, set Deploy Center › Scope to all.
[Open Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22deployCenter.scope%22)
welcome.error:
Could not read the projects. See the Deploy Center output for the reason.
[Refresh](command:deployCenter.refresh)
